claude.notes: The prompt is the ticket body (D2). Model routing: opus for cross-repo, parity-bound, contract-touching or hard tickets; sonnet for proven-isolated slices; flip per ticket via the ticket's worker:sonnet label. The mode MUST be bypassPermissions, never acceptEdits: acceptEdits auto-approves file writes only, so every shell command still prompts, and a -p worker has nobody to prompt. Measured on the ORB-75 Phase 7 run, where git switch, dotnet build/test/format, gh and orca were all denied and the worker delivered files with zero gates run, zero commit and zero PR.
